newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EVC increases E-PVC prices by 0.10 marks.
newsitem.headline: EVC increases E-PVC prices by 0.10 marks.

text.p: Europe's biggest PVC producer EVC International NV (EVC) said on Thursday it will increase the price of its E-PVC grades by 0.10 marks per kilo.
"The increase will be effective from October 1," EVC said in a statement.
"Demand has improved in recent months and the trend is expected to continue," said EVC's E-PVC business manager David Rolph in a statement.
EVC had already increased the price of its S-PVC resin to 1.15-1.25 marks per kilo and is evaluating the potential for a further increase in October, the company added.
Britain's ICI and Italy's Enichem jointly hold a minority stake in EVC.
